sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Riche is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The healer of a family of heroes who protected them all. After becoming a mother, Riche not only grew kinder, but stronger as well. As they traveled all over Grand Gaia, she healed everyone's wounds and served as the main pillar of support for the entire family. Even after her family was scattered across the world following a battle against a terrible demon, she believed in her heart that they had all escaped unscathed, and was the first one to begin the search for the other missing family members as soon as she was able.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Riche is Hogar's grandmother and Alma's great-grandmother
